entries.sense_en: fine, light and beautiful, and easily damaged

synonyms.nuance: Stresses only that something breaks easily; no idea of beauty or fineness.
Small, pretty and neat; often used for food, hands or manners, a little cute.
Weak in body, usually said of old or sick people, not of flowers or fabrics.

entries.sense_en: suddenly start to be covered with something (here, flowers)

synonyms.nuance: Even more sudden and dramatic; very common with flowers, tears and song.
Calm and gradual; just says the stage has been reached.
synonyms.example: The roses are coming into flower.

entries.tip_ko: break out into a sweat / a rash처럼 갑자기 뭔가가 몸이나 표면을 덮을 때 쓴다.

entries.sense_en: a huge, cruel creature in fairy tales that sometimes eats people

synonyms.nuance: Just a very big person-like creature; can be kind, as this story shows.
Ugly creature from Scandinavian tales living under bridges or in caves; today also an online troublemaker.
General word for any frightening creature, of any size or shape.

entries.tip_ko: 발음은 '오거'(/ˈoʊɡər/). 비유적으로 '무서운 상사' 같은 사람에게도 쓴다.

entries.sense_en: not very large; here, he had little to say

synonyms.nuance: Kept small by a rule or outside control, not by natural lack.
Used for interests or views; suggests a closed or small mind.
Formal; barely enough, used before uncountable nouns.

entries.tip_ko: Wilde의 농담: 할 말이 7년 만에 바닥났다는 뜻이다.

entries.sense_en: firmly decided to do something

synonyms.nuance: Neutral, everyday word; no idea of strong will.
Formal; a serious promise to oneself, often about behaviour.
Informal; the end of a period of thinking about choices.
synonyms.example: I can’t make up my mind.

entries.tip_ko: determine to do는 다소 옛 표현. 오늘날은 be determined to do(굳게 결심하다)가 흔하다.

entries.sense_en: low, rough and unfriendly-sounding

synonyms.nuance: Rough because of a sore throat or shouting; says nothing about mood.
Low and slightly rough, often attractive.
About manner, not sound: short and rude in speech.

entries.sense_en: a board on which a written message is shown to the public

synonyms.nuance: American word; usually indoors, with many papers pinned on it.
Any board with a short message, often a warning; the most natural word here today.

entries.tip_ko: notice board는 영국식, 미국은 bulletin board.

entries.sense_en: a person who goes onto someone’s land without permission

synonyms.nuance: Stronger; someone who enters a building or place, often to steal or harm.
synonyms.example: The alarm scared off the intruder.

synonyms.nuance: Formal; someone who joins a group or place where they are not wanted.
synonyms.example: She felt like an interloper at the party.

entries.tip_ko: 'Trespassers will be prosecuted'(무단 침입자는 고발함)는 영국 사유지의 전형적인 경고문이다.

entries.sense_en: officially accused of a crime in a court of law

synonyms.nuance: A private person takes someone to court, usually for money; not criminal.
The police formally accuse someone; a step before a trial.

entries.tip_ko: persecute(박해하다)와 헷갈리기 쉽다. pro-는 법정, per-는 괴롭힘.

entries.sense_en: walk slowly around without a clear purpose

synonyms.nuance: Over a wide area, freely, often for a long time.
A relaxed, pleasant walk for enjoyment.
Moves passively, pushed along with no aim or energy.

entries.tip_ko: wander /ˈwɑndər/(헤매다)와 wonder /ˈwʌndər/(궁금하다)의 모음을 구분하자.

entries.sense_en: a long, loose coat without sleeves; here, a layer that covers everything

synonyms.nuance: Usually shorter, covering the shoulders; think of superheroes.
As a metaphor, a thick even layer over the ground.
Literary; a loose cloak, or a covering layer, often also responsibility.

entries.sense_en: made a very loud, deep, continuous noise

synonyms.nuance: Long, high, wailing sound, like a wolf or strong wind.
A person or animal shouting in a deep, angry voice.
A single deep, loud sound, like a cannon or thunder.

entries.sense_en: a short pipe on top of a chimney

synonyms.nuance: The whole structure that carries smoke up; the pot is only the top part.
The inside passage for smoke, not the visible top.

entries.sense_en: small balls of ice that fall from the sky like rain

synonyms.nuance: A mix of rain and snow, or half-melted snow; softer than hail.
One single ball of hail; countable.
synonyms.example: hailstones as big as golf balls

entries.tip_ko: 동사 hail은 '(택시를) 부르다, 환호하다'라는 전혀 다른 뜻도 있다.

entries.sense_en: made quick, repeated knocking sounds by hitting something

synonyms.nuance: Louder, harder crashing sound of hard objects hitting each other.
Light, soft, quick taps, like gentle rain or small feet.
synonyms.example: the patter of rain on the window

synonyms.nuance: Steady, rhythmic beating.

entries.sense_en: thin flat pieces of grey stone used to cover a roof

synonyms.nuance: General word for any flat roofing or floor piece, often clay.
Usually wooden or asphalt roof pieces, common in America.

entries.sense_en: during the whole year, in every season

synonyms.nuance: Modern, compact form; also used as an adjective.
Casual; stresses how long the time feels.

entries.sense_en: a small brown songbird

synonyms.nuance: The bird family the linnet belongs to; broader term.
Any small bird that sings; no specific species.

entries.sense_en: stopped

synonyms.nuance: Everyday, neutral word for the same idea.
Sudden stop, often of movement or a process, sometimes by order.
Informal; a person gives up doing something on purpose.

entries.tip_ko: cease는 격식체. ceasefire(휴전)에 남아 있다. 발음은 '시스'(/sis/).

entries.sense_en: a pleasant smell, here from flowers

synonyms.nuance: Any smell, usually pleasant and light; also the smell animals follow.
Sweet, pleasant smell; slightly formal, used in advertising.
Mostly for food and drink, rich and warm.

entries.tip_ko: 오늘날 perfume은 주로 '향수(제품)'. 자연의 향기는 scent나 fragrance가 자연스럽다.

entries.sense_en: a window that opens outward on hinges at the side, like a door

synonyms.nuance: The general word; casement is a special type.
Slides up and down instead of swinging open.

entries.sense_en: moved slowly and quietly so as not to be noticed

synonyms.nuance: Quiet movement with a guilty or secret purpose.
Move on hands and knees; about body position, not quietness.
synonyms.example: The baby crawled to the door.

synonyms.nuance: Walk on the toes to stay quiet.

entries.tip_ko: 과거형 crept는 불규칙(creep–crept–crept).

entries.sense_en: making many quick, high, light sounds, as small birds do

synonyms.nuance: One short, sharp bird or insect sound.
Childlike word for a bird’s call; now also a social media post.
Singing with many changing notes, more musical.

entries.sense_en: with great sadness and pain

synonyms.nuance: So sad that nobody can comfort you; stresses hopelessness more than pain.
Everyday; cry hard focuses on how much, not how painful.

entries.tip_ko: bitterly cold(살을 에는 듯 추운), bitterly disappointed처럼 '몹시'의 뜻으로도 쓴다.

entries.sense_en: he suddenly felt love and pity instead of hardness

synonyms.nuance: Gradual and milder; less emotional.
Feel strong emotion, often to tears; no idea of earlier coldness.
synonyms.example: I was moved by her speech.

entries.sense_en: always, with no end; a stronger form of 'forever'

synonyms.nuance: Plain modern form, written as one word in American English.
Neutral, practical; about arrangements, not feelings.

entries.tip_ko: 동화와 기도문('for ever and ever, Amen')에서 흔한 강조 표현.

entries.sense_en: came close quietly, without being noticed

synonyms.nuance: Very close in meaning; slightly more common today, can sound threatening.
synonyms.example: Don’t creep up on me like that!

synonyms.nuance: Informal; often to surprise someone.

entries.tip_ko: 여기서 steal은 '훔치다'가 아니라 '몰래 움직이다'. steal a glance(몰래 흘끗 보다)도 같은 계열.

entries.sense_en: threw or moved (his arms) quickly and with energy

synonyms.nuance: Neutral; no sense of speed or strong feeling.
Light, careless throw.
synonyms.example: She tossed her keys on the table.

synonyms.nuance: Violent, very forceful throw, often in anger.
synonyms.example: He hurled a rock at the window.

entries.tip_ko: fling–flung–flung. 명사 fling은 '짧은 연애'라는 뜻도 있다.

entries.sense_en: morally bad and cruel

synonyms.nuance: Stronger and darker; deep, serious badness.
Everyday; unkind to others, small-scale.
synonyms.example: Don’t be mean to your sister.

synonyms.nuance: Only for children behaving badly; mild.

entries.tip_ko: 발음은 '위키드'(/ˈwɪkɪd/), 두 음절. 속어로는 '끝내주는'이라는 칭찬도 된다.

entries.sense_en: say goodbye to someone

synonyms.nuance: Plain everyday form.
synonyms.example: I said goodbye to my friends.

synonyms.nuance: Formal, old-fashioned; politely leaving someone.
synonyms.example: He took leave of his host.

entries.tip_ko: bid farewell, bid good night처럼 인사말과 쓰이는 문어체.

entries.sense_en: a person you spend time or play with

synonyms.nuance: Stresses affection; companion stresses being together.
Shared hardship, as in war or politics.
Someone you do an activity with, or a romantic partner.

entries.sense_en: make certain that you do something; don’t forget to

synonyms.nuance: The standard, more formal form of the same phrase.
synonyms.example: Be sure to lock the door.

synonyms.nuance: Everyday; slightly stronger reminder.

entries.sense_en: wanted very much to see or have someone, with sadness

synonyms.nuance: Everyday; feel sad someone is absent, less intense.
Literary, very deep and often painful desire.
Strong physical desire, often for food or drugs.

entries.tip_ko: 형용사 long과 달리 동사 long for는 '갈망하다'. longing(그리움)도 함께 알아 두자.

entries.sense_en: very weak in body, usually from age or illness

synonyms.nuance: Thin and delicate, looks easily hurt; very common for old people.
General word; can be temporary.
synonyms.example: I feel weak after the flu.

synonyms.nuance: Formal, medical; ill for a long time.
synonyms.example: care for the old and infirm

entries.tip_ko: a feeble excuse(궁색한 변명)처럼 '설득력 없는'의 뜻으로도 쓴다.

entries.sense_en: only; nothing more than

synonyms.nuance: Everyday spoken word for the same idea.
Often stresses that something is easy or plain.
synonyms.example: It’s simply a matter of time.

synonyms.nuance: Neutral; often about amount or number.

entries.sense_en: so wonderful that it causes amazement

synonyms.nuance: Very common, warm praise; less sense of astonishment.
Focuses on surprise, not on beauty or goodness.
Seems impossible, like a miracle.

entries.tip_ko: marvellous는 영국식, 미국식은 marvelous(l 하나).

entries.sense_en: went somewhere quickly

synonyms.nuance: Everyday word; often because of little time.
Very fast, sometimes careless.
synonyms.example: He rushed out of the room.

synonyms.nuance: A sudden short run.

entries.tip_ko: t는 소리 나지 않는다: '헤이슨'(/ˈheɪsən/). listen, castle과 같다.

entries.sense_en: an old form of 'has'

synonyms.nuance: The modern form used today.
The matching old form of 'does'.
synonyms.example: The lady doth protest too much.

entries.tip_ko: 성경·셰익스피어 말투. 거인이 갑자기 옛말을 쓰며 장면이 엄숙해진다.

entries.sense_en: hurt someone so that the skin is cut or broken

synonyms.nuance: General word, often from accidents, not weapons.
Everyday, broad; body or feelings.
Any damage, often abstract; less physical.

entries.tip_ko: 상처 wound는 '운드'(/wund/). wind(감다)의 과거 wound(/waʊnd/)와 발음이 다르다.

entries.sense_en: an old form of 'you' as an object

synonyms.nuance: The modern form for subject and object.
The old subject form: thou = you as subject.

entries.tip_ko: thou(주격)–thee(목적격)–thy(소유격). 원래 친근한 말투였으나 지금은 성경·기도문에서 엄숙하게 들린다.

entries.sense_en: kill violently, especially with a weapon

synonyms.nuance: Neutral, everyday word.
Unlawful and deliberate killing of a person; a crime word.
Killing many, cruelly, or animals for food.

entries.tip_ko: 문어·신화 표현(slay a dragon). 요즘 속어 slay는 '끝내주게 잘하다'.

entries.sense_en: an old word for 'no'

synonyms.nuance: The modern word.
Very casual spoken form.

entries.tip_ko: 오늘날은 의회 투표(yeas and nays)에 남아 있다.

entries.sense_en: old form of 'are you'

synonyms.nuance: The modern form.
The old past form, 'were you'.

entries.tip_ko: 여기서 art는 '예술'이 아니라 be동사의 옛 2인칭 형태.

entries.sense_en: a feeling of deep respect mixed with wonder and some fear

synonyms.nuance: Amazement and delight, without fear or respect.
Deep, calm respect, often religious; less fear or surprise.
Only the frightened part, with no admiration.

entries.tip_ko: awesome은 요즘 '끝내준다'지만 awe 자체는 무겁고 진지한 감정이다.

entries.sense_en: went down onto his knees, as a sign of respect

synonyms.nuance: Bend the head or upper body; still standing.
Bend low on the feet, often to hide or prepare; no respect.
Formal; bend one knee briefly in church.

entries.tip_ko: k는 묵음: '닐'(/nil/). 과거형은 knelt 또는 kneeled.

entries.sense_en: heaven; the perfect place where good people go after death

synonyms.nuance: The common religious word; also used for great happiness.
The garden of Adam and Eve; a perfect, innocent place.

entries.tip_ko: Paradise는 원래 '담으로 둘러싼 정원'이라는 뜻의 말에서 왔다. 거인의 정원과 짝을 이룬다.
